status: foundation registry with source-faithful Crewman's Primer wiki and staged Barotrauma RPG wiki conversion
sourceNotes: This workspace is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the creators or publishers of Barotrauma.
Original campaign prose, tables, and utilities should remain clearly separated from copied game text or extracted proprietary assets.
The Crewman's Primer is a source-faithful wiki conversion in which source-titled sections remain separate entries without summarization.
Barotrauma RPG.docx is being transferred into separate wiki entries one source section at a time without rewriting or summarization.

modules.title: The Crewman's Primer
modules.description: A searchable, source-faithful conversion of THE EUROPAN CREWMAN’S PRIMER. All 198 titled sections remain separate wiki entries in original manuscript order.

modules.title: Barotrauma RPG
modules.description: An exact wiki conversion of Barotrauma RPG.docx performed one source section at a time. Stage 1 contains the opening Test v 0.10 material; later sections remain unattached until their conversion stage is completed.

modules.title: Cult and Faction Dossiers
modules.description: Tracks organizations, ideologies, recruitment methods, public reputations, internal contradictions, operational risks, and campaign hooks, including the Children of the Honkmother and the Church of the Husk.

modules.title: Submarine Operations Console
modules.description: A table-side operations board for hull integrity, flooding, electrical load, reactor condition, oxygen, ballast, medical readiness, ammunition, supplies, repair priorities, and cascading failures.

modules.title: Crew and Personnel Generator
modules.description: Creates captains, engineers, mechanics, medical staff, security officers, assistants, specialists, passengers, liabilities, secrets, loyalties, grudges, qualifications, and psychologically dangerous coping mechanisms.

modules.title: Mission and Contract Generator
modules.description: Builds transport, salvage, rescue, survey, hunting, escort, recovery, medical, smuggling, military, and politically compromised contracts with rewards, hidden clauses, route pressure, and failure consequences.

modules.title: Emergency and Failure Cascade Generator
modules.description: Produces escalating submarine emergencies in which flooding, fire, electrical loss, reactor damage, oxygen depletion, hostile boarding, crew panic, and bad repair decisions interact instead of occurring as isolated events.

modules.title: Abyssal Creature and Threat Catalogue
modules.description: A campaign-facing threat index for hostile fauna, parasites, environmental dangers, behavioral signs, attack patterns, evidence, defensive doctrine, and the consequences of misidentification.

modules.title: Depth Detective Case Builder
modules.description: Constructs closed-environment investigations aboard submarines and stations, including victims, suspects, motives, contradictory testimony, physical evidence, system logs, false leads, creature involvement, and solvable revelation chains.

modules.title: Outpost, Wreck, and Salvage Site Generator
modules.description: Creates inhabited stations, abandoned facilities, broken submarines, sealed compartments, salvage rights, survivors, contamination, structural hazards, valuable systems, and reasons the site was left alone.

modules.title: Campaign Logbook and Incident Ledger
modules.description: Records voyages, contracts, casualties, injuries, repairs, supply expenditure, crew discipline, faction standing, unresolved evidence, infected personnel, recovered artifacts, and the accumulating institutional memory of a submarine crew.
